اصطلي (form VIII)
# اُصْطُلِيَ (uṣṭuliya) /usˤ.tˤu.li.ja/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِصْطَلَى (iṣṭalā)
# اِصْطَلِي (iṣṭalī) /isˤ.tˤa.liː/: second-person feminine singular imperative of اِصْطَلَى (iṣṭalā)
